title: Verify the Incursa tooling portfolio
scope: All public extension repositories, standalone tool packages, extension-pack metadata, release workflows, and the unified per-user installer.
verification_method: Run each repository's committed release gate and the Windows installation matrix, then reconcile the evidence with docs/acceptance-matrix.md.
procedure: Run unit, integration, webview, extension-host, and browser-host tests applicable to each product.
Inspect browser bundles for forbidden desktop dependencies.
Inspect VSIX, ZIP, executable, and installer contents and identities.
Verify byte counts, SHA-256 values, component pins, and confidentiality scan results.
Exercise fresh install, selections, modify, repair, upgrade, uninstall, missing prerequisites, offline operation, and tamper rejection.
Record reproducible commands, commits, packages, workflow URLs, Marketplace status, and limitations in docs/portfolio-plan.md.
expected_result: Every required acceptance row is complete with reproducible evidence, or an optional prerequisite-bound capability is accurately reported as limited without overstating coverage.
